Question: Janab mufti sb. Asslalama alaikum Thanks and jazakallah for the reply for my matter regarding fatwa no. 11436. In response to your reply I want to ask futher- 1. What is the impact of one talaq on our married life? 2. What to do to rectify the one talaq? Thanks in advance for your resopnse. Answer ID: 12258 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 685/685=M/1430) By one talaq if you mean revocable talaq, the husband can take back his wife without Nikah just by a word or an action. But, if the iddah is over, or he gave Talaq Bain, he cannot get her back without new Nikah. What do you mean by ?rectifying?. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
